headlines.headline: Haemonetics Announces CE Mark Certification for the VASCADE MVP XL Venous Vascular Closure System
headlines.summary: Haemonetics Corporation has received CE Mark certification for its VASCADE MVP XL venous vascular closure system, marking a regulatory milestone for the medical technology company.

headlines.headline: Appian Announces 2026 Partner Award Winners at Appian Europe
headlines.summary: Appian recognized several leading partners across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) for their contributions to delivering AI-powered automation solutions during the Appian Europe conference.

headlines.headline: Appian Advances Control Plane Capabilities for AI Agents
headlines.summary: Appian announced new agent management and orchestration capabilities at its annual Appian Europe conference to help organizations ensure AI agents deliver reliable business value.

headlines.headline: Hinge Health Insider Reports Sale of Shares
headlines.summary: An insider at Hinge Health, Inc. has sold shares of the company's stock, according to a recent regulatory filing.

headlines.headline: Jefferies Initiates Coverage on Haemonetics With Buy Rating
headlines.summary: Jefferies has initiated coverage on Haemonetics Corporation with a Buy rating and a price target of $150.

headlines.headline: Andersen Group Inc. Announces Five New Acquisition Agreements
headlines.summary: Andersen Group Inc. has entered into five new acquisition agreements aimed at expanding the technology and strategic advisory capabilities of its Andersen Consulting division.

headlines.headline: Stifel Maintains Bullish Rating on Hinge Health
headlines.summary: Analyst David Grossman of Stifel Financial has reaffirmed a bullish rating on Hinge Health (HNGE) and maintained a price target of $135.

headlines.headline: Citigroup and Barrington Research Update Analyst Ratings for Haemonetics
headlines.summary: Financial analysts at Citigroup and Barrington Research issued updated price targets and maintained positive ratings for Haemonetics Corporation on November 6, 2026.

headlines.headline: Barrington Research Adjusts Haemonetics Price Target to $145
headlines.summary: Barrington Research has increased its price target for Haemonetics Corporation from $140 to $145 while maintaining an Outperform rating.

headlines.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Appian Price Target to $57
headlines.summary: Morgan Stanley has increased its price target for Appian Corporation to $57 from $32 while maintaining an Equalweight rating.

headlines.headline: William Blair Upgrades Appian to Outperform
headlines.summary: William Blair has upgraded Appian Corporation's stock rating from Market Perform to Outperform.

headlines.headline: Appian Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
headlines.summary: Appian Corporation reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, highlighting growth in cloud and total subscription revenues.

headlines.headline: Haemonetics Corporation Announces Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
headlines.summary: Haemonetics Corporation released its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, covering the period ended September 26, 2026.

headlines.headline: Andersen Consulting Enters Collaboration with Bakia Consulting
headlines.summary: Andersen Consulting has formed a strategic collaboration with Paris-based Bakia Consulting to enhance its business transformation and financial management advisory services.

headlines.headline: TD Cowen Maintains Appian at Hold, Raises Price Target to $50
headlines.summary: TD Cowen has maintained its 'Hold' rating on Appian Corporation while increasing its price target from $30 to $50.

headlines.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Hinge Health Following Q3 Earnings
headlines.summary: Multiple financial institutions, including RBC, Truist, and Morgan Stanley, updated their price targets for Hinge Health following the company's Q3 2026 earnings report.

headlines.headline: Hinge Health Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Executive Leadership Changes
headlines.summary: Hinge Health announced strong Q3 2026 financial results, including a 52% year-over-year revenue increase, and disclosed upcoming changes to its executive leadership team.

headlines.headline: Hinge Health Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results and Updates Full-Year Guidance
headlines.summary: Hinge Health, Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $235.0 million and adjusted earnings per share of $0.71, both exceeding analyst expectations.

headlines.headline: Andersen Group Inc. Announces Closing of Three Strategic Acquisitions
headlines.summary: Andersen Group Inc. has finalized the acquisition of Andersen in the Netherlands, Clareo Partners, and Endeavor Management as part of its ongoing global expansion strategy.

headlines.headline: Appian Announces 2026 US Public Sector Partner Award Winners
headlines.summary: Appian recognized GovCIO, Groundswell, and Ignyte as winners of its 2026 US Public Sector Partner Awards.

headlines.headline: Appian Announces US Army Fielded TACTMIS System
headlines.summary: Appian announced that the US Army has fielded the Total Army Combat and Training Munitions Information System (TACTMIS), built on the Appian Defense Cloud.

headlines.headline: Appian Defense Cloud Achieves IL5 Provisional Authorization
headlines.summary: Appian announced that its Appian Defense Cloud (ADC) has received Impact Level 5 (IL5) Provisional Authorization to Operate from the US Department of War.

headlines.headline: Harvard Pilgrim Health Care Expands Partnership with Hinge Health
headlines.summary: Harvard Pilgrim Health Care has expanded its relationship with Hinge Health to provide members with increased access to digital musculoskeletal care and pain management programs.

headlines.headline: Andersen Consulting Enters Collaboration Agreement with John Keells IT
headlines.summary: Andersen Consulting has announced a new collaboration with Sri Lanka-based technology solutions provider John Keells IT to expand its digital and business transformation capabilities.

headlines.headline: Appian and PSI CRO Form Strategic Partnership to Advance AI-driven Clinical Trial Operations
headlines.summary: Appian and PSI CRO have launched a joint AI-powered process orchestration solution designed to automate clinical trial site identification and selection.

headlines.headline: Stifel Raises Hinge Health Price Target to $130 from $115
headlines.summary: Stifel analyst David Grossman maintained a 'Buy' rating on Hinge Health, Inc. and increased the price target from $115 to $130.

headlines.headline: BofA Securities Adjusts Hinge Health Price Target to $130 From $110
headlines.summary: BofA Securities has updated its price target for Hinge Health, raising it from $110 to $130.

headlines.headline: Andersen Consulting Broadens Technology and AI Services Through TechSparq Collaboration
headlines.summary: Andersen Consulting has formed a collaboration agreement with U.S.-based digital consulting firm TechSparq to enhance its technology and business transformation offerings.

headlines.headline: Andersen Global Strengthens Legal Capabilities in Argentina Through Collaboration with MHR
headlines.summary: Andersen Global has entered into a collaboration agreement with the Argentine law firm Martínez de Hoz & Rueda (MHR) to enhance its legal service offerings in the region.

headlines.headline: Andersen Consulting Expands Capabilities Through Collaboration with Algoruni
headlines.summary: Andersen Consulting has entered into a collaboration agreement with Uzbekistan-based firm Algoruni to enhance its cybersecurity and business transformation service offerings.

headlines.headline: Haemonetics Announces FDA Approval of PerQseal® Elite Vascular Closure System
headlines.summary: Haemonetics Corporation has received FDA approval for its PerQseal® Elite vascular closure system, designed for large-bore arterial procedures.

headlines.headline: Andersen Global Expands Private Client Tax Capabilities Through Collaboration with KTA Tax
headlines.summary: Andersen Global has entered into a collaboration agreement with Dublin-based tax practice KTA Tax to enhance its private client tax services in Ireland.

headlines.headline: Appian to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 5, 2026
headlines.summary: Appian Corporation has scheduled the release of its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, for November 5, 2026.

headlines.headline: Andersen Group Inc. Closes Four Consulting Acquisitions
headlines.summary: Andersen Group Inc. announced the closing of four consulting acquisitions—SPR, BD Emerson, Daniels Consulting Group, and Zenger Folkman—to accelerate its global expansion.

headlines.headline: Andersen Group Inc. Appoints Two Senior Executives to Board of Directors
headlines.summary: Andersen Group Inc. has appointed longtime senior executives Daniel DePaoli and Peter Coscia to its Board of Directors to strengthen operational expertise.

headlines.headline: Barclays Maintains Underweight Rating on Appian Corporation
headlines.summary: Barclays has reaffirmed its Underweight rating on Appian Corporation, reflecting the firm's current stance on the enterprise software company.

headlines.headline: Andersen Consulting Enters Collaboration Agreement with TalentSmartEQ
headlines.summary: Andersen Consulting has partnered with TalentSmartEQ to enhance its human capital and leadership development services through emotional intelligence-based training.

headlines.headline: BofA Securities Maintains Haemonetics Buy Rating and Raises Price Target to $140
headlines.summary: BofA Securities analyst Travis Steed maintained a Buy rating on Haemonetics and increased the price target from $120 to $140.

headlines.headline: Barrington Research Adjusts Price Target on Haemonetics to $140
headlines.summary: Barrington Research has increased its price target for Haemonetics Corporation from $118 to $140 while maintaining an Outperform rating.

headlines.headline: Haemonetics Announces CSL Plasma Rollout Timeline for NexSys PCS Devices
headlines.summary: Haemonetics Corporation disclosed that CSL Plasma expects to complete the transition to its NexSys PCS devices and disposables across all current U.S. locations by the end of 2027.
